exposure: Hysterectomy at the time of cesarean delivery
Controls (women who did not develop postoperative ileus)
cohort: This study included 147 women who developed postoperative ileus after cesarean delivery and 294 controls who did not develop ileus, matched by age and BMI.
finding: Preeclampsia, exposure to general anesthesia, estimated blood loss >1 L, and transfusion of blood products were identified as potential risk factors for postoperative ileus after cesarean delivery.
